name: M12 modulo-bias rejection removed (maxFair = 2^32)
why: DECLARED SURVIVOR, and this is the honest face of MANIFEST premise 1. CORRECTED 2026-09-10 (QA-12): this note used to say the branch was never taken 'in any of the 172,500 draws the capture contains, nor in the 24,000,000 Pass-1 rounds'. The first half is measured and stands — the capture census is 0 rejections in 172,500 draws against an expectation of 2.024e-4, and a Poisson approximation puts the chance that a capture THIS SIZE ever witnesses the branch at about 0.02024%, which is small and NOT zero: 'this capture did not' is a measurement, 'no capture could' is not a claim anyone is entitled to. The second half was wrong. The Pass-1 seed space DOES exercise it, and the vector is now a unit test (tests/mines/qaRegressionTests.ts, QA-12): serverSeed 1f1da0da5907129a0043f5ac8a12b5ee, clientSeed 097bf01483879668f626781b35b297c2, nonce 760455, cursor 12, range 13 — the seed pair of the committed Pass-1 mineCount=5 row. maxFair there is 4294967287; the first chunk is 4294967288 and IS rejected; the second chunk 412214211 yields 6, where deleting the branch would yield 1. Cursor 12 is past the first 5 tiles, so that round's mine layout [24,4,25,9,16] is IDENTICAL either way while the full 25-tile permutation is not — which is exactly why this mutation still survives a layout-scoped verifier and why the survival is a scope fact, not an absence-of-rejection fact. The branch remains ASSUMED as OPERATOR behaviour — read from the client bundle, never witnessed on their side, and no client-side capture can witness it — see rng-algorithm-analysis.md and findings.md F16. Declared here — in tests/survivors.json, run and printed by the same gate — rather than quietly omitted, because a registry that hides its survivors reports a coverage it does not have.

name: M27 EDGE_NUM rebuilt at 1e2 scale instead of 1e8 (numerically identical at a 1% edge)
find: export const EDGE_NUM = BigInt(Math.round((1 - HOUSE_EDGE) * 1e8));       // 99_000_000n at 1%
why: DECLARED SURVIVOR BY CONSTRUCTION, and the most instructive one here. At HOUSE_EDGE = 0.01 the 1e2-scaled form yields exactly 99000000/100000000 — the same rational — so nothing in the suite can tell the two apart and the run is clean. The damage is invisible until the edge moves: at HOUSE_EDGE = 0.0100001, Math.round(0.9899999 * 100) rounds straight back to 99 and mutation M02 (edge shifted in the 5th decimal) would go back to reporting 0 floor8 violations, which is the H-H defect returning under a different spelling. Kept here so the reason EDGE_SCALE is 1e8 rather than 1e2 is recorded as an executed counterexample rather than as a comment nobody re-derives.

why: A fail-open replay guard can still accept honest inputs, so this source mutation is not detectable from those inputs alone. Forged invalid and partial replay metadata are exercised by A28–A30 and must fail under the unmodified verifier.
